test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Her handwriting is definitely more beautiful than your.
solution:
The correct answer is **'than your'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, **a comparative degree **has been used.
 
• During the comparison, we normally **compare the same type of part of speech with others**.
 
• Here, **Her handwriting is being compared with your handwriting.**
 
• But the **sentence can not be ended **with **the possessive determiner 'your'.**
 
• We normally end such sentences with **the possessive pronoun and in this case, it should be 'yours'.**
 
• So, the sentence would be - ***Her handwriting is definitely more beautiful than yours.***

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the difference between **the possessive determiner and the possessive pronoun.**

 
• Is that **your** shirt? - (possessive determiner)
 
• That is not **your** house. - (possessive determiner)
 
• This shirt is similar to **mine.** - (possessive pronoun)
 
• That jacket is not **hers**. - (possessive pronoun)
